trait.name: Camouflage
entries: The stalker has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made while in marshy or muddy terrain.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6+2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail Slap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8+2}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.
